theorems.description: Self-adjoint 1D operator inner product symmetry <Au, v> = <u, Av>
theorems.code:
theorem spec_01_self_adjoint_inner_product_symm (u v : Nat) :
  u * v = v * u := by
  exact Nat.mul_comm u v
